description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment of Secretaries to State Ministries (Ministry of Digital Technology and State Ministry of Urban Development)
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Mr. Jayantha de Silva, Mr. Sirinimal Perera) and their detailed portfolio responsibilities (Secretary to the State Ministry of Digital Technology and Enterprise Development, Secretary to the State Ministry of Urban Development, Waste Disposal and Community Cleanliness), making it a Hybrid Gazette under the classification rules.
